notes.text: In Pesachim, Chama speaks in Rabbi Yose bar Chanina’s name. Berakhot gives Rav Shimi bar Ukva or, in the alternative reading, Mar Ukva. Heilprin has separate entries for [Rav Chama bar Ukva](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1355&lang=en) and [Rav Shimi bar Ukva](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3299&lang=en). The shared patronymic alone does not establish a common father.
